podcast.title: Production of Queen of the Stone Age's 2017 Album
podcast.body: Mark Ronson served as the producer for Queen of the Stone Age's 2017 album, a choice initially considered unusual due to his diverse production credits spanning artists like Wu-Tang Clan, Garbage, and Adele. "La producción venía a cargo del famoso productor Marc Bronson que era un poco extraño porque es el típico productor profesional que tan pronto hace trabajo de producción para el gután clan como para Lidya Garbage, como para Adele."

srcs.source: Music Radar Clan

podcast.title: "Uptown Funk" Grammy Acceptance Speech
podcast.body: During the 2016 Grammy acceptance for Record of the Year for "Uptown Funk," Mark Ronson and Bruno Mars explicitly credited and thanked numerous funk and soul pioneers, including James Brown, George Clinton, Jamal Lewis, Prince, The Meters, and Earth, Wind & Fire, acknowledging their foundational influence on the song. "So I want to thank James Brown, George Clinton, Jamal Lewis, Prince The Metas, Earth Wind and Fire of course, and I'm sure these guys want to say something really quick."

podcast.title: Collaboration with Daisy Lowe
podcast.body: English guitarist Mark Ronson had a relationship with Daisy Lowe and collaborated with her on some recording projects. "She had a thing with English guitarist Mark Ronson even did some recording with him."

podcast.title: Collaboration with Mark Rankin
podcast.body: Mark Ronson and Mark Rankin, who co-produced Queen of the Stone Age's 2017 album, had a pre-existing working relationship, having collaborated on the production of an Adele album, which facilitated their effective teamwork. "los dos marques los los productores se conocían porque trabajaron juntos haciendo la producción de algún trabajo de Adele, algún disco de Adele."

podcast.title: Contemporary Catalog Sale
podcast.body: Mark Ronson is listed as a contemporary act who has sold some or all of his back catalog, participating in the trend where artists secure large financial payouts for their existing body of work.

podcast.title: Grammy & Oscar Wins
podcast.body: Mark Ronson is a British-born, American-raised producer with a decorated career, having won Grammys for producing hits by Amy Winehouse and Adele. He later achieved further critical acclaim by winning an Oscar for co-writing Lady Gaga's song "Shallow," showcasing his broad impact across different music and media. "Mark Ronson, the British born American-raised producer who had already won Grammys for Helming Hits by Amy Winehouse and Adele."

xref.title: Plaintiff in "Uptown Funk" Lawsuit
xref.body: The Gap Band was one of several groups to sue Bruno Mars and Mark Ronson over their song "Uptown Funk," leading to a split of songwriting credits and royalties with additional parties. "They were sued by the Gap Band, a rap group called The Sequence, another called Kalash, and another called Zap."

xref.title: Plaintiff in "Uptown Funk" Lawsuit
xref.body: Victoria, a Serbian singer, was one of the individuals who accused Bruno Mars and Mark Ronson of plagiarism for their song "Uptown Funk," contributing to the broad distribution of the song's songwriting credits and royalties. "They were even accused of plagiarism by a Serbian singer named Victoria."
